title: Winless Chargers eager to play spoiler vs. Rams with healthier roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Winless Chargers eager to play spoiler vs. Rams with healthier roster
sources.description: Injuries have played a key role in the Chargers' 0-6 start to the season, but Joe Alt, Ladd McConkey and Tre' Harris are all set to play against the Rams.
